fixture_purpose: Smoke-test the /qc-council Stage 5 hard gate by replaying the 2026-05-21 Wave-1 council with G2 + G4 proposals — both should be falsified by baseline measurement.

proposals.title: Strip .page-id-N scope prefix in cv2 matcher
proposals.diagnostic_claim: cv2's _collect_css_decls_for_element returns 0 hits for SGS-registered blocks because css_router emits scope-prefixed selectors that the bare-selector matcher rejects.

fix_shape.change: Add re.sub for leading scope prefix at top of per-selector loop

proposals.title: Strip WP chrome from pixel-diff screenshots
proposals.diagnostic_claim: Per-section pixel-diff is inflated 10-20pp uniformly because screenshots include WP admin bar + sgs-header above each section.

fix_shape.change: Insert page.evaluate() to remove #wpadminbar + .sgs-header before el.screenshot()

G2.reason: Baseline (no fix applied) matched post-fix prediction: cv2 never received scope-prefixed CSS because the SGS clone runner only fed it mockup inline <style> rules, never the generated variation CSS file. The strip is a no-op on the actual input.
G2.return_to_stage_0_with: Two-step fix needed: (a) SGS clone runner merges variation CSS into _section_css; (b) cv2 strips the prefix when it now appears in input.

G4.reason: Post-fix measurement equalled baseline within noise: el.screenshot() already clips to element bounding box, so chrome above the element was never in the captured pixels. The DOM removal has no effect on cropped output.
G4.return_to_stage_0_with: Diagnosis is wrong: contamination is not in cropped screenshots. Re-investigate where the perceived inflation actually comes from.

expected_stage_8_summary.saved_cycles_line: Saved 1 wave of subagent work + commit-merge cycles + a re-baselining session by catching 2 no-op proposals pre-dispatch.

expected_auto_memory_invocations.summary: When a fix-shape proposal strips/normalises input at the CONSUMER, verify the consumer actually receives that input. Producer side may need a separate fix.
Selector-cropped screenshots via Playwright el.screenshot() already exclude content outside the element bounding box. Chrome strips have no effect in this measurement mode.

smoke_test_assertion: After running /qc-council on this fixture, the resulting Stage 8 report MUST contain falsified verdicts for both proposals and MUST NOT have dispatched any Stage 7 implementer subagent.
human_check: Read scripts/fixtures/example-council.json + references/example-council-walkthrough.md side by side. The walkthrough is the prose form of the same fixture.
